title: Family Sitting Under Bridge, 1946 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white family snapshot taken on New Year's Day, January 1, 1946. The family of four—a man, woman, small girl held on her father's lap, and a young boy wearing a side cap—is seated outdoors against a rocky embankment beneath a concrete bridge or overpass. Taken just months after the end of World War II, this image reflects the early post-war period of American domestic life.
